theater_event_24_04_04_001:
—Mr. Bell. These marks weren't all made by
pickaxes. They're probably carrying axes and
other weapons too...
theater_event_24_04_04_002:
Yeah... Makes sense if they're adventurers.
Let's go carefully.
theater_event_24_04_04_003:
Honestly... Trying to grab the gold by brute
force... Who on earth are these guys? I'd love
to meet the god who raised 'em.
theater_event_24_04_04_004:
Goddess, maybe you really should go back to
the tavern...
theater_event_24_04_04_005:
What are you talking about? If they're adventurers,
they're children too, right? Unlike monsters,
not many kids would dare lay a hand on a god.
theater_event_24_04_04_007:
Once, it was arrogance and carelessness that
brought us a defeat steeped in disgrace...
theater_event_24_04_04_008:
Never forget that mistake! We will wash away
this humiliation! No one slacks off until we
reach our goal!
theater_event_24_04_04_010:
Drive out any intruders on sight. That great
gold nugget will be the cornerstone of the
Apollo Familia's revival!
theater_event_24_04_04_012:
Mr. Hyacinthus?!
What's he doing here...?
theater_event_24_04_04_013:
Raising funds to rebuild the Apollo Familia,
I'd guess? They had all their assets seized
after the War Game.
theater_event_24_04_04_014:
They got kicked out of the city, and still
Apollo hasn't learned his lesson...
theater_event_24_04_04_015:
We beat them once, but Hyacinthus is Level 3,
same as you, Mr. Bell...
theater_event_24_04_04_016:
And that elf beside him... Lissos, was it?
He was Level 2, too...
theater_event_24_04_04_017:
There are way too many of them. And we've got
Lady Hestia with us. Let's fall back for now
and rethink our plan.
theater_event_24_04_04_018:
...Yeah, you're right.
First, let's get the Goddess somewhere safe...
theater_event_24_04_04_019:
HEEEEEY, YOOOU!
You kiiiiids over there!
theater_event_24_04_04_021:
—What?! Bell Cranel?!
Why are you in a place like this...?!
theater_event_24_04_04_023:
Lady Hestia!
What do you think you're doing?!
theater_event_24_04_04_024:
Pipe down! Why should we be the ones sneaking around
when they're the ones bullying the miners?!
theater_event_24_04_04_025:
We paid our mining registration fee too! We've
got every right to dig here, fair and
squaaare!
theater_event_24_04_04_026: Although Lord Hermes paid that fee...
theater_event_24_04_04_027:
Besides, we already beat these guys to a pulp once!
Bell, let's teach 'em another lesson!
theater_event_24_04_04_028:
The lights of a town burning with gold rush fever...
the fire in the hearts of kids digging for a happy
life... I won't let anyone put them out—!
theater_event_24_04_04_029: After all, I'm the goddess of the hearth!
theater_event_24_04_04_031: Honestly... It always ends up like this, doesn't it?
theater_event_24_04_04_032:
Same as ever. Besides, we've fought them before and
know how they work. Could be worse, right, Bell?
theater_event_24_04_04_036:
Ahh! Even in a place such as this,
the red string of fate binds us together...
theater_event_24_04_04_037:
Come now, my sweet angel! Spread those
snow-white wings and fly into my arms!!
theater_event_24_04_04_038: Where did YOU crawl out from?!
theater_event_24_04_04_039:
Fwahahahaha!
Wherever Bell is, there I shall be, Hestiaaa!
theater_event_24_04_04_042: Apollo's the one who came over here on his own!!
theater_event_24_04_04_043:
Fwahahahahaha!
Love is such a sinful thing, Hestiaaa!
theater_event_24_04_05_001:
Isolate them as much as you can!
Bell Cranel is mine to finish!
theater_event_24_04_05_003: Gimme a break, a free-for-all right off the bat?!
theater_event_24_04_05_004:
Looks like that masked elf isn't here! A shame
I won't get my revenge on her... but for now,
I'll just do my duty!
theater_event_24_04_05_006:
What's wrong, Bell Cranel?! The power you showed
that day was more than this, wasn't it?!
theater_event_24_04_05_007:
Ahh! Bell-kyun and Hyacinthus...
fighting over me...?!
theater_event_24_04_05_008:
Yes! Oh, this is simply divine!!
Please, you two, don't fight over meeeee!!
theater_event_24_04_05_009:
Like Bell would ever fight for YOU?!
Give your delusions a rest already!
theater_event_24_04_05_010:
Let's wrap this up fast, Bell!
With this magic sword and your magic—!
theater_event_24_04_05_013:
This mine's been dug all over without any
plan! Too fierce a fight could bring the whole
thing down...!
theater_event_24_04_05_017: Do you really have time to look away?
theater_event_24_04_05_019:
How long I have dreamed of this day...!
I won't let up until you're groveling in the dirt!
theater_event_24_04_05_020:
Men! Crush them flat! This time, we offer a golden
victory to the god we adore!!
theater_event_24_04_06_002:
N-no way...?! We're being pushed back,
with these numbers...?!
theater_event_24_04_06_003: Damn it! That accursed magic-sword smith...!!
theater_event_24_04_06_004:
Hmph! Bell and the others have been through
plenty of tough fights since the War Game!
Don't underestimate them!
theater_event_24_04_06_005:
Ahh! Splendid! Simply splendid, Bell-kyun! To
think you kept honing yourself, dreaming of
our reunion!
theater_event_24_04_06_007:
Tch... We haven't been idling around
since we were banished from Orario either!
theater_event_24_04_06_008: Lissos! Use the terrain—put up a barrier!!
theater_event_24_04_06_009:
Got it! All units, forward— With true loyalty
and love for our god in your hearts, withstand
every blow!
theater_event_24_04_06_012:
"My name is love, child of light. I offer myself
to my sun! My name is sin, jealousy of the wind!"—
theater_event_24_04_06_024:
*cough, cough* We're fine over here!
Lady Hestia's safe too!
theater_event_24_04_06_025:
That's insane...! They caused a cave-in
themselves...!
theater_event_24_04_06_027:
He's... inside the dig site.
We've been... cut off...
theater_event_24_04_06_028: So this was those kids' plan all along...
theater_event_24_04_06_030:
Heh... The others seem to have escaped,
but as long as you, my real target, remain,
that's no problem.
theater_event_24_04_07_002: Damn it! What's with this rock? It's rock-solid...!
theater_event_24_04_07_006: It's coming from inside the dig site!!
theater_event_24_04_07_008:
Wh-wh-wh-what?! What on earth is going on in there?!
Don't tell me he and Bell...?!
theater_event_24_04_07_009: Which means... Mr. Bell's all right?!
theater_event_24_04_07_010:
Hang in there, Bell!
I'm coming to get you!
theater_event_24_04_07_015:
Ah-ah-ah... At this rate, Bell's gonna fall
into Apollo's evil clutches...?!
theater_event_24_04_07_016:
Now, Bell-kyun! Toward our Love Dream,
we dig and dig and dig some more!!
theater_event_24_04_07_017:
P-please get off me, Lord Apollo...!
And I don't know anything about a "love dream"!
theater_event_24_04_07_020:
*cough, cough*... Wow, that thing's something.
Welf's magic swords sure are amazing.
theater_event_24_04_07_022:
I brought Fubu along just in case, and you go
and fire it off on your own?! Give me a break!
theater_event_24_04_07_026: Heh... It seems there's been some misunderstanding.
theater_event_24_04_07_028:
I am a slave of love, devoted to Bell-kyun body
and soul...! As if I would ever harm him!
theater_event_24_04_07_030:
U-um, Goddess... This time, he's actually
telling the truth. Though the way he clung to
me was weird...
theater_event_24_04_07_034:
Lord Apollo, why do you stop me...? If he's in
Golden, he's after the gold nugget too...
Clearly his interests clash with ours—
theater_event_24_04_07_035:
If it's the gold you seek, we want the same thing.
Why must we fight and hurt each other?
theater_event_24_04_07_037:
Our goal and theirs is the great nugget the Gnomes
spoke of! Fellow seekers of an unseen treasure—
there's no reason we can't join hands!
theater_event_24_04_07_041:
Yes, it's love, Hyacinthus! Love alone can
swallow up all the countless troubles of the
mortal world!
theater_event_24_04_07_042:
I, love incarnate, beg of you!
Don't rob me of this chance to embody loooove!
theater_event_24_04_07_043: (I have no idea what he's talking about...!)
theater_event_24_04_07_044:
...All is as Lord Apollo wills. We of the
familia shall devote ourselves to your love.
theater_event_24_04_07_046:
(Fwahahahaha! Fall for me! Fall at first
sight, Bell-kyun! For this gentleman! This
apostle of looooove!)
theater_event_24_04_07_049:
...Ahem. And so, Bell-kyu... Bell. To begin with,
I never wished to fight you myself.
theater_event_24_04_07_051:
Come, let us join hands and go forward
together! Toward the great nugget that will
light our future gold—
theater_event_24_04_07_054:
It's simple. If upper-class adventurers fight each
other, the mine is all that suffers. I've no wish
for such barbarism that leaves everyone miserable.
theater_event_24_04_07_055:
In that case, when the great nugget is found,
do we split it down the middle?
theater_event_24_04_07_056:
Of course. I swear it on my love!
So there you have it, Hestia! Let us cooperate
and claim our riches together!
theater_event_24_04_07_057: Don't go deciding that on your own!
theater_event_24_04_07_058:
Fwahaha! No need to be shy! We were lovers once,
back in the heavens! I know you better than anyone!
theater_event_24_04_07_059:
When you say no, you mean yes!
That is how we nurtured our love!
theater_event_24_04_07_060:
We were NOT lovers, and I'm not into that kind
of thing! You're not listening to a word I
say!
theater_event_24_04_07_061:
Heh, and now I have Hestia's blessing! I'm
counting on you too, Bell! Let's be good...
close... friends. Fuuu...!
theater_event_24_04_07_063: I said stop clinging to hiiiim!!
theater_event_24_04_08_002: I'll haul away the rocks you've broken, okay?
theater_event_24_04_08_004:
Lissos, we'll show those people the gap in our
strength! Dig, dig, and keep on digging!
theater_event_24_04_08_005:
I know! I have no intention of falling behind
that vulgar rabble!
theater_event_24_04_08_006:
Hahaha! Spurring each other on and growing.
How beautiful the ways of children are, Hestia!
theater_event_24_04_08_007:
...Honestly. Thanks to you lot taking over the mine,
the whole town's been having a rough time.
theater_event_24_04_08_008:
Oh my. Is that so? When I get absorbed in something,
I lose sight of everything around me. A bad habit.
I'll be more careful.
theater_event_24_04_08_010:
Still, with two Level 3s together,
we're really making good time.
theater_event_24_04_08_018: The great nugget from the Gnomes' legend...
theater_event_24_04_08_019: I never imagined it'd be this huge...
theater_event_24_04_08_020: This place... It's like one of the Dungeon's rooms.
theater_event_24_04_08_021:
Yes, and there's hardly any sign of mining.
There shouldn't be much risk of a cave-in...
theater_event_24_04_08_022:
Ha-hahahahaha!
This is it! The great nugget we've been seeking!
theater_event_24_04_08_023: With this... With something this big...!!
theater_event_24_04_08_024:
The ultimate form of love! A giant golden pietà
of Bell-kyun and me can finally become realityyy!!
theater_event_24_04_08_026:
Lord Apollo?! Wasn't the nugget meant to fund
the familia's revival...?!
theater_event_24_04_08_027:
Kufu... Kufufufufu!
For love's sake! Love has granted me a revelation!
theater_event_24_04_08_028:
Ahh! Drowning in love, a captive of love, I
knew there was no other way to fully express
my love for Bell-kyun!!
theater_event_24_04_08_030:
Now, my beloved followers!
Seize the great nugget for us!
theater_event_24_04_08_031:
Remove anyone who stands in our way!
Oh, but capture Bell-kyun as unharmed as you caaan!!
theater_event_24_04_08_033: Hey?! You guys are fine with that?!
theater_event_24_04_08_034:
Naturally. Answering Lord Apollo's love is the form
my love takes! We answer love with love!
theater_event_24_04_08_035:
Barbarians who can't grasp the depth of Lord
Apollo's love! You'll learn the power of love!
theater_event_24_04_08_037:
Guhuhuhuhu! Prepare yourself, Bell-kyuuun!
I'm never letting you go back to Orariooo!
theater_event_24_04_08_038:
Gaaaaaah!!
You're sneaky to the bitter end, aren't you?!
theater_event_24_04_08_039:
Say what you will!
I merely follow the urges of love!
theater_event_24_04_08_043:
A fine opportunity. Accursed magic-sword
smith... I'll settle my fellow elves'
long-held grudge here and now!
theater_event_24_04_08_044:
...I couldn't care less about my moldy old
ancestors, but...!
theater_event_24_04_08_045:
Bring it on!
Come at me!
theater_event_24_04_09_002:
Ngh...! You... Without a magic sword,
you can do this much...!
theater_event_24_04_09_003: Can't keep riding on Bell's back forever, after all.
theater_event_24_04_09_005:
This guy... He's gotten faster again...!
And this technique, these mind games...!
theater_event_24_04_09_008: Amazing! Bell and Welf are both pushing them back!
theater_event_24_04_09_009:
The Apollo Familia got banished from the city,
after all.
theater_event_24_04_09_010:
Having the Dungeon to earn excelia or not
makes a huge difference in how fast you grow.
It's only natural.
theater_event_24_04_09_011:
What ARE you?!
What did you do to get so strong so fast...?!
theater_event_24_04_09_012:
Um... We got attacked by the Ishtar Familia
and had to fight, and a lot of stuff happened...
theater_event_24_04_09_013:
What... You were involved in Ishtar being sent
back...?! Don't tell me you fought Phryne, a
first-tier adventurer, and Anteianeira too...!
theater_event_24_04_09_014: Um, well... I did fight them.
theater_event_24_04_09_015:
How can this be?! I heard Ishtar had been sent
back, but to think it was the work of my
beloved Bell-kyun?!
theater_event_24_04_09_016:
Ahh, you spurned the goddess of beauty just to come
see me! Let us spread the wings of love and soar
to new heights togetherrrr!!
theater_event_24_04_09_017: Um... Can I go punch that god now...?
theater_event_24_04_09_018:
I know how you feel... Actually, I wanna punch
him...
theater_event_24_04_09_019:
—Bell Cranel. I hate you...! You receive such
deep divine love, and you stubbornly refuse it!!
theater_event_24_04_09_021:
Then for that grave sin... I won't kill you,
but I'll carve it into your body before I
present you to Lord Apollo!
theater_event_24_04_09_022: I can't afford to lose either!
theater_event_24_04_09_023:
Never again, to anyone...!
I have to get stronger...!
theater_event_24_04_10_002:
"My name is love, child of light. I offer myself
to my sun! My name is sin, jealousy of the wind!"
theater_event_24_04_10_003:
Concurrent Casting?!
He couldn't do that during the War Game...!
theater_event_24_04_10_004:
He must've been training hard in his own way.
So he wouldn't get left behind by Bell.
theater_event_24_04_10_005:
Ngh...!
He's not the same as before either—!
theater_event_24_04_10_006:
"I call a gust of wind upon me.
The flaming wheel I hurl! Come, west wind!"
theater_event_24_04_10_011: Fool! You think I'll let you escape?!
theater_event_24_04_10_013: Fwahahaha!! How long can you keep running?
theater_event_24_04_10_019:
Run, run, run, run, run, run, run, run, run, run,
run, run, run, run, run, run, run, run, run, run,
run, run, run, run, run, run, run, run!
theater_event_24_04_10_021: The magic... It can't "catch up" to Bell...
theater_event_24_04_10_030:
Ahh... Bell-kyun, how far will you go...
Now, leap straight into my arms!
theater_event_24_04_10_033:
...So, what'll it be? Your god and your captain
are both out cold... Still wanna keep going?
theater_event_24_04_10_034: Tch... But at least the gold...!
theater_event_24_04_10_040:
...Fwahahaha! There it is, there it is!
So this is the great nugget the Guild mentioned!
theater_event_24_04_10_042: Oh. So you came here too, lad.
theater_event_24_04_10_043:
Wh-why is an executive of the Loki Familia
in a place like this...?!
theater_event_24_04_10_044: And why did you come busting out of a wall?!
theater_event_24_04_10_045:
Fwaha! When there's a rock wall in front of you,
a miner breaks through it!
theater_event_24_04_10_047:
Old skills die hard, as they say. The Guild gave me
a mandatory mission to fetch this great nugget
the Gnomes sensed.
theater_event_24_04_10_049:
If a nugget this big hit the market, the value of
gold would crash. Markets would be thrown into
chaos, and the world economy might fall apart—
theater_event_24_04_10_050:
So it fell to me to dig it out.
Well then—I'll be taking this.
theater_event_24_04_11_001:
Ugghhhhh!! What was all that about?!
In the end, we didn't mine a single fleck...
theater_event_24_04_11_002:
Even so, what can you do when it's Elgarm
you're up against?
theater_event_24_04_11_003:
Haha... So the dwarf who was like a "Lambton,"
that was Mr. Gareth, huh?
theater_event_24_04_11_004:
Huh... Gareth...
You mean THE Gareth of the Loki Familia?!
theater_event_24_04_11_005:
That's right. And that very Gareth
ran off with the great nugget from this mine!
theater_event_24_04_11_006:
Shame, but... well, if the legendary miner did it,
he must have had some deep reason.
theater_event_24_04_11_007:
Gaah! I can't believe he came to Golden! I wanted to
at least shake his hand! Big brotheeeeer!!
theater_event_24_04_11_008:
What's with that overwhelming trust
and mysterious popularity?!
theater_event_24_04_11_010: Ow ow ow! Hestia... Stop pulling!
theater_event_24_04_11_011:
Now, swear it in front of everyone! That you
won't do anything obnoxious like taking over
the mine again!
theater_event_24_04_11_012:
But... I must gather gold as soon as possible,
for my pietà of Apollo featuring Bell-kyun...
theater_event_24_04_11_014:
—J-j-just kidding, obviously!
I promise never to commit such barbarism again.
theater_event_24_04_11_015: If you break that promise, you'll be sorry!
theater_event_24_04_11_016:
Being punished by Bell-kyun would be a reward,
really... What sort of punishment will it be,
my angel?
theater_event_24_04_11_018:
(Ahh! Bell-kyun's looking at me like some hideous
monster! This gives me chills in its own waaay!!)
theater_event_24_04_11_019: Stop looking at Bell with those dirty eyes!!
theater_event_24_04_11_021:
—And there you have it, miners!
From now on, don't worry about them.
Dig for gold to your hearts' content!
theater_event_24_04_11_022: I guess that settles things for now.
theater_event_24_04_11_023:
Yeah. With a ruckus big enough to bring in the
Guild, nobody's gonna try anything stupid for
a while.
theater_event_24_04_11_024:
But... we didn't earn a thing...
And it's all because of this pervert god!
theater_event_24_04_11_028:
You were down in the mine all day, kicked up
a whole ruckus, and there's not a scratch on 'em?
theater_event_24_04_11_029:
And they look real easy to move in, too.
They sell clothes that amazing in Orario?
theater_event_24_04_11_031:
—Yes! The clothes they're wearing are the mining
wear of a new divine age! And the star of the
show: the trousers Bell's wearing! The Hermes 777!
theater_event_24_04_11_032: Hermes?! What are you doing here...?
theater_event_24_04_11_033:
Well, I figured word of your exploits
would be getting around about now.
theater_event_24_04_11_034:
Though... I never imagined you'd go so far
as to tangle with the Apollo Familia.
theater_event_24_04_11_035:
Ahem! The mining wear worn by the heroes who saved
this town from the Apollo Familia's evil clutches!
theater_event_24_04_11_036:
For this golden time only,
just 30,000 valis! Only 30,000 valis!
theater_event_24_04_11_037:
Dig in the mine all day and not get a single
scratch! Come on, come on, buy now! Grab gold
in your hands with brand-new clothes ☆
theater_event_24_04_11_039:
One for me too! And maybe I'll pick up
that Prum outfit for my daughter!
theater_event_24_04_11_040:
—So you used us to advertise and sell this
mining wear. That's why you sent us here.
theater_event_24_04_11_042:
The goods are actually good, though. With the
gold rush, there's plenty of customers flush
with cash. Smart thinking.
theater_event_24_04_11_043:
Meanwhile, us... *sigh* At this rate, we'll go
back to Orario empty-handed...
theater_event_24_04_11_044:
—Oh! In that case!!
Let's take a page out of Hermes's book!
theater_event_24_04_11_046:
This town's got as much energy and buzz as Orario!
So then—!
theater_event_24_04_11_047:
—Welcome! They'll be ready in a jiffy,
so buy, buy, buy!
theater_event_24_04_11_048:
Orario's famous Jyaga Maru-kun! We've also got
the Golden-exclusive Golden Jyaga Maru-kun!
theater_event_24_04_11_049:
Jyaga Maru-kun made by a goddess? Sounds like
good luck! Gimme one!
theater_event_24_04_11_051:
Hyoooooh! Bell-kyun! I'll buy hundreds of them,
so feed me with an "aaah"!
theater_event_24_04_11_052:
We don't offer that kind of service here!
Come on, we're busy, so please don't get in the way.
theater_event_24_04_11_054:
Haha, I never thought we'd come all the way
to Golden just to make money off Jyaga Maru-kun.
theater_event_24_04_11_055:
Good food is the same everywhere! Besides,
even with prices high from the gold rush,
everyone's happy to buy!
theater_event_24_04_11_056:
Our "golden time" is just getting started!
Bell, go buy us more potatoes!
theater_event_24_05_01_002:
Unlike warm spring, when hearts flutter at new
encounters... Unlike hot summer, when lovers meet
with hearts burning with passion...
theater_event_24_05_01_003:
It is—the season when mature men and women
exchange vows of peace!
theater_event_24_05_01_004:
Say "marriage," and one pictures the most
beautiful, sacred ritual of love in this world,
where two lovers wish for an eternity together...
theater_event_24_05_01_005: ...But not a single god here thinks that way!!
theater_event_24_05_01_006:
We gods know! The poison bug, black as
darkness, that lurks behind the sweet, melting
word "marriage"!
theater_event_24_05_01_007:
We gods remember! The hellfire of mad jealousy
that grossly misread the words "eternal love"!
theater_event_24_05_01_008:
We gods never wanna see her agaaaain! That
crazy psycho, hyper ultra hysteric destroyer—I
mean! That terrifying goddess!!
theater_event_24_05_01_012:
You know her name at least, right, Bell? The patron

theater_event_24_05_08_030:
I can't... I'm at my limit...
Why don't Ms. Ais and the others ever get tired...?
theater_event_24_05_08_031:
The Hera Familia's obsession with marriage might be
giving them limitless stamina.
theater_event_24_05_08_032:
I've got plenty of thoughts about marriage myself,
but the depth of their feelings surprises me.
theater_event_24_05_08_033:
I... don't really get it...
I've never really thought about marriage, but...
theater_event_24_05_08_034:
I thought it'd be something more peaceful,
happier... A special bond that just keeps
going forever...
theater_event_24_05_08_035: I thought it was something wonderful like that...
theater_event_24_05_08_038: But that's what's good about you.
theater_event_24_05_08_042: We've found a way to calm them dooooown!!!
theater_event_24_05_09_001:
Go, you two!
My familia will take it from here!
theater_event_24_05_09_003:
My children! Even a few seconds will do!
Buy us tiiiiime!! It's Ganesha Sooouul!!
theater_event_24_05_09_006: I'm off to the great beyooooond!!
theater_event_24_05_09_007: Thanks for those few seconds, my childreeeeen!!
theater_event_24_05_09_009:
Nuuuuuuuuuh!! I won't move just because
you tell me to—I'm ele-fant firm about that!
theater_event_24_05_09_010:
When you get down to it, this whole mess is my
fault! So it's only right for a god to take
responsibility, even if it costs me my life!
theater_event_24_05_09_013: Yes, ma'am, moving aside riiiiight now!!!
theater_event_24_05_09_015: Have you found a way to calm them down?
theater_event_24_05_09_016:
I can't say for sure it'll work.
But right now, it's all we've got.
theater_event_24_05_09_017: Wh-what are we going to do...?
theater_event_24_05_09_018:
A prayer to break the curse. What set their feelings
loose were lines full of hatred for cheating men.
theater_event_24_05_09_019:
If words set them loose, it should be possible
to calm them with words the same way.
theater_event_24_05_09_020:
"Should be"—isn't that way too uncertain? And
 if you had something like that, you should've
 tried it sooner.
theater_event_24_05_09_021:
We didn't have one.
More precisely, we didn't until just now.
theater_event_24_05_09_022:
We wrote it while you two were running around.
It's a rush job, a total patchwork.
theater_event_24_05_09_023:
Whether it'll strike a chord with "the feelings the
goddess's followers left behind" is, like you said,
nothing more than an uncertain gamble.
theater_event_24_05_09_024:
Hmm, I understand how we got here. There doesn't
seem to be any other way... So we just read it?
theater_event_24_05_09_025:
Glad you're quick on the uptake. They're fixated on
you two right now. They won't calm down unless
the words come from you yourselves.
theater_event_24_05_09_026:
If there's even a little chance...!
We have to hurry, or Ms. Ais and the others...!
theater_event_24_05_09_027:
Indeed. Sitting here waiting to die isn't what
I want either. I'll humbly accept it, Lord
Hermes.
theater_event_24_05_09_029: So this is the prayer to break the curse...
theater_event_24_05_09_032:
This is... impossible.
I can't read this...!
theater_event_24_05_09_034:
Bell Cranel... you're the man for the job.
Put an end to this ridiculous mess!
theater_event_24_05_09_035:
Huh, wha—something even you can't do, Mr. Finn,
and I'm supposed to...?
theater_event_24_05_09_036: —?! That apocalyptic sound of destruction is—?!
theater_event_24_05_09_038:
Read it, Bell, quick! The prayer to break the
curse!!
theater_event_24_05_09_039:
Ugh...! Okay!
I just have to read this, right?!
theater_event_24_05_09_040: WAIT?! Th-this is what it SAYS—?!
theater_event_24_05_09_041:
It can only be you, Bell Cranel!
You're the one who'll end it all!
theater_event_24_05_09_042:
Mr. Finn, isn't that kind of unfair?!
U-uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuh!!
theater_event_24_05_09_043:
—"My beloved honey ♪ You're the only wife
 for me, baby!!"
theater_event_24_05_10_001:
"My one and only kitty cat.
 What's got you in such a bad mood?"
theater_event_24_05_10_002:
"Did I make you worry?
 Silly you. You know the truth deep down."
theater_event_24_05_10_003:
"The one I love is the only one in this world—
 and that's YOU!!"
theater_event_24_05_10_005:
"All I ever think about is you.
 All I ever long for is you."
theater_event_24_05_10_006:
"It's embarrassing, but it's no lie.
 I can't think of anything but you."
theater_event_24_05_10_007: "As long as you're in my world, that's all I need!"
theater_event_24_05_10_009: Ooh, it's working! It's working, Bell!
theater_event_24_05_10_010:
Is that working?
Aren't they just confused?
theater_event_24_05_10_011:
No idea, but it's now or never!
Keep it coming, Bell!
theater_event_24_05_10_012:
"And as proof, right here and now! I hereby issue
 my 'Passionate Only-You Declaration'!!"
theater_event_24_05_10_013:
"To the one and only princess living on Bell Island,
 my Love Declaration is for you alone!!"
theater_event_24_05_10_014:
"I swear it as leader of the Only You Party!
 You're just too 'only you,' baby!!"
theater_event_24_05_10_016: Your words are getting all mixed up, Braver!
theater_event_24_05_10_017:
...Pardon me. But that was a close call. If
I'd shown that face to the public, forget
reviving the Prum race...
theater_event_24_05_10_018:
Well, seems this turn of events suited the prayer's
"author" just fine, too.
theater_event_24_05_10_020:
There's no way I could come up with phrases that
cringey. I asked someone else to do it.
theater_event_24_05_10_021:
I told them to freely write
"lines they'd like to hear"—
theater_event_24_05_10_023:
Did you hear what Bell just said?!
To think Bell would ever say lines like that!
theater_event_24_05_10_024:
Aaagh, didn't anybody record that with magic
or something?! What a waste, what a waste,
what a waaaste!
theater_event_24_05_10_025:
Looks like she's using this chance to indulge
her desires to the fullest.
theater_event_24_05_10_026: So the goddess of the sacred flame is a "god" too...
theater_event_24_05_10_031:
You just spit out pretty words like that,
and then you'll betray me again anyway...!
theater_event_24_05_10_032:
MEN are ALWAYS like that...!
I DON'T BELIEVE "only you"...!
theater_event_24_05_10_033:
There's no such thing in this world as a man
who cherishes and loves one woman to the end!!!
theater_event_24_05_10_036:
The prayer didn't work!
No, actually, did it backfire...?
theater_event_24_05_10_037:
The Hera Familia's will is pushing to the surface
even harder than before!
theater_event_24_05_10_038:
Whaaat?! Even after I said those
embarrassing lines?!
theater_event_24_05_10_039:
What do you mean, embarrassing lines?!
I thought those up seriously, you know!
theater_event_24_05_10_040: YOU came up with those, Goddess?!
theater_event_24_05_10_041:
Yep. Thanks to you, I'm completely full now!
Thanks for the treat!
theater_event_24_05_10_042: Why are you smiling like that?!
theater_event_24_05_10_043: Tione! Can you hear me, Tione?!
theater_event_24_05_10_044: Kill... Kill... Cheating men must die...!
theater_event_24_05_10_045:
Even my voice isn't reaching her...
Has her body been completely taken over?!
theater_event_24_05_10_046: Looks like things have gotten seriously bad.
theater_event_24_05_11_001:
—To love one woman and one alone, to the end.
Why is that so hard?
theater_event_24_05_11_002:
Simply being together always, always by my side,
speaking only to me forever, looking only at me
for all eternity—
theater_event_24_05_11_003:
THAT'S NOT HARD, IS IT? YOU CAN DO IT, RIGHT?
IT'S ONLY NATURAL...
theater_event_24_05_11_004: ONLY ME, ONLY ME, ONLY ME—
theater_event_24_05_11_005:
H-hey, aren't the Hera Familia's followers
getting even sicker, Hermes?
theater_event_24_05_11_007: Oh, the setting sun's so bright.
theater_event_24_05_11_009: It's fine... I won't rush you right away...
theater_event_24_05_11_010:
Yes, yes. Slowly, thoroughly... I'll make you
love me right down to the marrow of your
bones...
theater_event_24_05_11_011:
I'll wait forever and ever and ever—
until you can see no one but me—
theater_event_24_05_11_012: Just the two of us, forever—!
theater_event_24_05_11_014:
S-so heavy... As expected of the empress's
familia... Wait, what are you doing?
theater_event_24_05_11_018:
The n-nightmare... The nightmare of the empress's
era is coming back...
theater_event_24_05_11_019: W-we'd better run, or we're done for...
theater_event_24_05_11_020:
YOU WON'T ESCAPE—
I'll chase you to the ends of hell!
theater_event_24_05_11_022:
To our love nest, even if I have to break your
limbs!
theater_event_24_05_11_023:
TOGETHER FOREVER! TOGETHER FOREVER!
TOGETHER FOREVER! TOGETHER FOREVER!
theater_event_24_05_11_028: ...Why do you all look like you're in so much pain?
theater_event_24_05_11_030:
I don't know what happened to you,
the goddess's followers...
theater_event_24_05_11_031:
I'm sure it was really painful... Maybe it was
harder than someone like me could ever
imagine...
theater_event_24_05_11_032: But... is marriage really something that unhappy?!
theater_event_24_05_11_033:
I've never really thought about it, so I don't know,
but I thought marriage was something more
wonderful, and kind...
theater_event_24_05_11_034:
Becoming "a special pair"—
isn't that all it needs to be?!
theater_event_24_05_11_036:
Making women sad is a bad thing.
So... I'll declare it right here!
theater_event_24_05_11_037:
If... if I ever... um...
end up with someone I love, and get m-married...
theater_event_24_05_11_038:
...I'll never, ever cheat!! I swear I'll love
only that person for my whole life!!
theater_event_24_05_11_039:
I... I don't want to think that marriage...
is something so painful...!
theater_event_24_05_11_041:
How young... The words of a naive boy—
And yet they're pleasant to hear—
theater_event_24_05_11_042:
It seems we forgot in the depths of our hatred—
that "marriage" is pure-hearted words,
a declaration of love—
theater_event_24_05_11_043: So men like this still exist—
theater_event_24_05_11_044:
Don't ever forget
that pure heart of yours—Darling ♪
theater_event_24_05_11_045:
...A prayer to break the curse, huh? Turns out you
could've recited one without us writing any lines.
theater_event_24_05_11_046:
Huh...? Huh? What are you talking about?
Actually, what just happened...?
theater_event_24_05_11_049:
What happened to us...?
Weren't we in the middle of the ritual...?
theater_event_24_05_11_050:
Ms. Ryu! Ms. Ais, and Ms. Tione too!
Are you back to normal?!
theater_event_24_05_11_051: Back to normal... What do you mean?
theater_event_24_05_11_052:
...So Bell Cranel was the right man for the
job after all. I could never say lines like
that.
theater_event_24_05_11_053:
Captaaain. What's going on?
Did something weird happen?
theater_event_24_05_11_054: ...No, I suppose it was business as usual.
theater_event_24_05_11_055:
More importantly, that outfit looks good on
you, Tione.
theater_event_24_05_11_056: WHAT?!?! What did you just say?!
theater_event_24_05_11_057:
Well, the ritual's over.
Shall we head back home?
theater_event_24_05_11_058:
Wait a second, Captain!
You just complimented me, right?! Riiight?!
theater_event_24_05_11_059:
What is going on?
Did something happen to us?
theater_event_24_05_11_060:
...Looks like it's all been resolved.
I'm really glad you two are okay...
theater_event_24_05_11_063:
What do you mean, "what's wrong"!
You don't have to say it, I already know!
theater_event_24_05_11_064:
Those lines just now—
you were saying them to me, right?!
theater_event_24_05_11_066:
That was totally a marriage proposal!
Aww, you're making me bluuush ♪
theater_event_24_05_11_068: N-no, it wasn't?! That's a misunderstanding!
theater_event_24_05_11_069:
You said such things...?
When you have Syr...!
theater_event_24_05_11_070:
Bell made a proposal... proposal...
...What's a proposal?
theater_event_24_05_11_071:
I'm telling you, no! The Goddess is causing
all kinds of weird misunderstandings!
theater_event_24_05_11_072:
There's nobody you'd say those lines to but me!
So it's the same as saying them to me!
theater_event_24_05_11_073:
Or are you saying you had someone else in mind?
You cheateeeeeer!!
theater_event_24_05_11_074:
What on earth did you say?!
Tell me everything, Mr. Cranel!
theater_event_24_05_11_075:
Proposal... Pro... pose? A pro's pose?
Bell, what amazing pose are you gonna do?
theater_event_24_05_11_077:
...His woman troubles never end, do they?
He really is your grandson, Zeus.
